old_constants.formula: flops = steps x fl_move x C (Search.result; no restarts)

formula: per puzzle = steps x C x move + start + ceil(steps / 4096) x check; steps = old flops / (124 x 4) (Search.result: stop_t of the first passing chain, or the moves run at the cap)
notes: The kernel count per move equals the old fl_move (124): the transcription counts the neighbour-field updates (3 D: weight multiply, subtract, add), the Gumbel transform (4 d), the heat-bath logits (2 d + 2) and the energy and certificate (4) plus 2 integer scalar operations; the old count had 4 D + (D + 1) + (2 d + 1) + 4, whose focus comparisons are not counted now.
Steps are stop_t, the first passing move; the chains run on to the next check (up to 4,095 more moves each). The old formula and this rebuild both charge stop_t only.
